description: Fix the skin weights of one spot of a rigged .glb (afk.ai/rig's Fix a spot) and write a new .glb. Pick the spot with where (every given condition must hold), then: follow (it moves with the wrong part: give it to bone), smooth (pinched, jagged or creased: strength light, medium or strong) or redo (it tears or sticks to another part: its weights worked out again from the nearest bones). Reports the bones the spot follows [before, after]. Runs on this computer, free.

mesh.description: a mesh by name (inspect_rig lists them)

moves_with.description: skin following any of these bones by at least min_weight; "thigh_l*" is the bone and every bone below it

piece_at.description: the connected piece of the model nearest this point: one strap, glove or shell

bone.description: follow: the bone the spot should move with

file.description: a rigged .glb (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory): one rig_model wrote, or any model on afk.ai's skeletons

output.description: where to write the result (default: the next free <model>-v2.glb, -v3... beside it; never the input)

type.description: the body type, when it can't be told from the file (afk.ai's files say)

where.description: the spot: near a joint, moving with bones, a mesh, a piece, a box or a sphere (all given must hold)

name: fix_spot
